node.title: L1 quotient-chart bipolar entropy closure
node.statement: In one genuine quotient/coset common-pencil chart, orient every petal support and every exact core defect fiber as sparse or dense. The exceptional point counts are exactly the petal polarity p_pet and symmetric core polarity p_core. At the L1 cutoff the M+N orientation bits cost only 2^(M+N)<=n^(1/c_0); bounded exceptional sets cost n^(P_0+B_0); and the whole-strip CRT bounds cost q^(2P_0). Thus every fixed bipolar box has at most (P_0+1)(B_0+1)n^(1/c_0+P_0+B_0+2 gamma P_0) contributors per source chart. Any super-polynomial fixed-chart family must have unbounded petal or symmetric core polarity; cross-chart and arbitrary-locator branches remain open.
